name: Piper TTS
tagline: Fast, lightweight local neural text-to-speech system optimized for low-power hardware and real-time voice.
real_test_summary: Tested synthesizing speech offline on CPU with ONNX voice models. Starts almost instantaneously and runs smoothly on lightweight laptops and embedded boards without a GPU.
pros: Very fast CPU inference and tiny memory footprint with ONNX voices
Runs completely offline with zero API keys or latency delays
MIT open-source license with CLI and HTTP server modes
cons: Less expressive emotional range than heavy voice-cloning models
Requires downloading separate ONNX voice checkpoints per speaker
